292:When `options` is passed to `effect`, the adapter/client call receives the same object identity (`signal`, `deadline`, `timeoutMs`). When `effect(input)` is called without options, the underlying Effect client method is invoked with arity 1 (no `undefined` options argument). Success and failure paths leave caller `input` and `options` structurally equal to a pre-call snapshot; `options.signal` identity is unchanged. An already-aborted or then-aborted signal fails with the abort error (or tagged cancel), not `not_found` / `end_of_list`, including abort during `search` / `listAll` / `trainingSummary` page N (fails the program, not a successful partial catalog — later-page **404** remains end-of-scan per VAL-OPS-004). Two sequential `effect()` calls on one instance do not leak soft-404 flags or items. Two concurrent `effect()` programs on one instance resolve independently. `trainingSummary`, `routines.search`, `templates.listAll`, and `folders.listAll` forward the same `HevyExecutionOptions` to every page request. One `HevyOperations` instance can run concurrent `effect()` programs for different domains without shared mutable request state leaking.

### VAL-OPS-002: Collapse boundary: domain map/catch/quirks live in effect(); optional execute is a single runPromise; tests collapse at the edge

Normalize, tagged-error recovery, pagination mismatch, mutation quirks, and composite scans execute inside `effect()`, not inside an `async execute` body. If `execute` exists it is a single `Effect.runPromise(this.effect(input, options))` with the same arguments and contains no `catchIf` / `map` / page-normalize / payload-build / `while (` pagination. Domain modules do not `runPromise` around map/catch. Tests obtain values by running `operation.effect(...)` with `Effect.runPromise` / `runPromiseExit` (or the thin `execute` one-liner). Fail if `effect-collapse.test.ts` still requires `execute.toString()` to contain `Effect.runPromise` **and** `Effect.catchIf` together.

Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/effect-collapse.test.ts` and `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`

### VAL-OPS-003: PaginationMismatchError is Schema.TaggedError with requested, received, collection; never throw new Error; never a soft-404 success

When a paginated list that returns `page` receives a different number than `input.page`, the Effect fails with `PaginationMismatchError` (`_tag === "PaginationMismatchError"`, fields `requested`, `received`, `collection` for `workouts` / `routines` / `bodyMeasurements` / `workoutEvents` as applicable). Fail if the error is a plain `Error`/`TypeError`, if list source `throw new Error` for page mismatch, if a mismatch test only matches `error.message` on a generic `Error`, or if mismatch succeeds with `expected404Outcome`.

Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/operation-errors.test.ts`, `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`, `packages/operations/src/routines.test.ts`, `packages/operations/src/body-measurements.test.ts`

### VAL-OPS-004: Soft-404 policy matrix for every collection

Expected 404 recovery is collection-scoped. Writes are never soft-success. Sibling/unrelated 404s are never recovered. Abort is never converted into soft-404 (see VAL-OPS-008). Pass only if every row holds.

| `workouts.list` page > 1 on `/v1/workouts` | GET 404 | success `{ items: [], page, pageCount: undefined, expected404Outcome: "end_of_list" }` |
| `workouts.list` page === 1 | GET 404 | fail tagged (not `end_of_list`) |
| `workouts.get` member `/v1/workouts/:workoutId` | GET 404 | success `{ workout: null, expected404Outcome: "not_found" }` |
| `workouts.get` collection `/v1/workouts` | GET 404 | fail (not `not_found`) |
| `workouts.events` page > 1 on `/v1/workouts/events` | GET 404 | success `events: []`, `expected404Outcome: "end_of_list"` |
| `workouts.events` page === 1 | GET 404 | fail |
| `routines.list` page > 1 on `/v1/routines` | GET 404 | success `{ items: [], page, pageCount: undefined, expected404Outcome: "end_of_list" }` |
| `routines.list` page === 1 | GET 404 | fail |
| `routines.get` member `/v1/routines/:routineId` | GET 404 | success `{ routine: null, expected404Outcome: "not_found" }` |
| `routines.get` collection `/v1/routines` | GET 404 | fail |
| `routines.search` later-page collection 404 | GET 404 | complete with items so far (end of scan) |
| `routines.search` page 1 collection 404 | GET 404 | fail the program (not a successful empty catalog) |
| `templates.get` member `/v1/exercise_templates/:id` | GET 404 | success null template + `expected404Outcome: "not_found"` |
| `templates.get` collection `/v1/exercise_templates` or unrelated | GET 404 | fail |
| `templates.history` | GET 404 | **fail** (not soft-success) |
